mission: Determine whether one exactly bound candidate artifact, configuration, dependency set and target environment has complete current independently validated evidence sufficient for non-authorizing deployment admission eligibility; do not release, authorize, deploy, operate, monitor, roll back, observe production as an authority, reconcile effects or execute external action.

fixed_certification_boundary.category_1: A declared Layer 17 invariant fails in a valid abstract history and can produce an invalid assurance PASS or ADMISSION_ELIGIBLE disposition without first requiring failure of a legitimately deferred implementation mechanism.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_2: A physical implementation or runtime obligation explicitly allocated to a future owner class with rationale, prerequisites, evidence, failure behavior and future certification condition.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_4: Documentation or non-material reconciliation unable to produce invalid assurance or admission eligibility.

semantic_separation.CONFORMANCE: Layer 16-owned requirements a realization must satisfy.
semantic_separation.ASSURANCE: Layer 17 independent evaluation of current evidence for one exact candidate/environment tuple.
semantic_separation.ADMISSION: Layer 17 non-authorizing eligibility to request separately owned deployment authorization.
semantic_separation.AUTHORIZATION: Layer 01-owned Human or expressly delegated authority for an exact deployment.
semantic_separation.EXECUTION: Performance of a protected deployment or rollback outside Layer 17 and constrained by Layer 14.
semantic_separation.OBSERVATION: Operational evidence produced by future mechanisms; Layer 17 may specify pre-admission evidence but owns no monitoring.
semantic_separation.RECONCILIATION: Resolution of partial, unknown or conflicting effects outside Layer 17.

owns: assurance evidence membership and currentness disposition
assurance invalidation, staleness, supersession and revocation
does_not_own: Layer 15 engagement, evidence, conclusion, decision or handoff semantics
build, deployment, operation, monitoring or rollback
authority_boundary.future_reservation: External-Action Execution and Effect/Outcome Reconciliation remains separately governed and unnumbered.

derivation_rules.object_schema: Project every object field, authority, cardinality, rank and prohibition without semantic addition or omission.
derivation_rules.transition_schema: Project every transition exactly from transition_rules.
derivation_rules.dag_node: Create one node for every object_type.
derivation_rules.dag_edge: Create one directed edge for each transition source type to its destination type.
derivation_rules.rank: Every edge must satisfy destination rank greater than source rank.
derivation_rules.documentation: May explain this model but may not add authority, mandatory predecessors, states, transitions, invariants or closure criteria.
derivation_rules.reconciliation: Compare projected object IDs, state families and edge tuples for exact equality with this normative model.

invariants.text: Every admission decision binds exactly one candidate identity and immutable artifact version/hash.
Every admission decision binds exactly one current environment identity and generation.
Every admission decision binds exactly one configuration and dependency-manifest generation.
Every applicable predecessor reference binds exact identity, version, hash, authority owner, boundary, lifecycle and currentness.
Every assurance-evidence set has explicit exact membership; missing is not empty.
Evidence provenance is immutable, reconstructable and source-authority preserving.
Stale, superseded, revoked, expired, conflicting or cross-boundary evidence cannot support PASS or eligibility.
Candidate, artifact, configuration, dependency, environment, purpose or scope substitution requires a new assurance generation.
The producer, builder or deployer cannot independently validate its own Material candidate.
The assurance validator is independent of every Material evidence producer whose work it certifies.
Assurance PASS cannot create release, deployment, recovery, access, risk-acceptance, exception or external-action authority.
ADMISSION_ELIGIBLE cannot exist without a current PASS and every exact admission guard satisfied.
ADMISSION_ELIGIBLE remains non-authorizing and cannot itself cause deployment.
Layer 01 remains the sole certified owner of deployment authorization.
Layer 14 remains the sole formal owner of protected-action runtime-enforcement semantics.
Layer 16 remains the owner of realization-conformance requirements; Layer 17 cannot weaken or reinterpret them.
Revocation, expiry, supersession or Material predecessor change invalidates affected assurance and admission decisions.
Rollback-readiness evidence proves only plan/evidence sufficiency and cannot authorize or execute rollback.
Incomplete evidence fails closed.
Conflicting Material evidence fails closed and cannot be resolved by aggregation, voting, confidence score or validator preference.
Audit and telemetry are descendant evidence and cannot create, repair or revive assurance or authority.
Every transition moves strictly forward in rank; no validation or audit artifact becomes an authority predecessor.
No production mechanism is treated as implemented, available, effective or empirically certified merely because its contract exists.
External-action execution and effect/outcome reconciliation remain outside Layer 17.

deferred_implementation.failure_behavior: artifact evidence incomplete and candidate ineligible

deferred_implementation.rationale: architecture specifies exact membership but cannot inventory a runtime candidate

deferred_implementation.rationale: architecture cannot instantiate or identify a production environment physically

required_evidence: security, privacy, impersonation and cross-boundary test results
